title: ULSAN NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Act is to establish the Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology in order to train advanced science and technology experts who will play a leading role in innovating advanced science and technology of the Republic of Korea and developing technology and knowledge of regional industries, and contribute to national science and technology development by promoting cooperative research with industrial circles and the exchange of education and research with foreign countries.
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015]

Article 2 (Legal Personality) The Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology (hereinafter referred to as "UNIST") shall be a legal entity.
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015]
  [Moved from Article 3; previous Article 4 Deleted]

Article 3 (Registration of Establishment) (1) UNIST shall be duly formed by obtaining the registration for the incorporation thereof at the location of its principal office. <Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015>
  (2) Matters necessary for the registration for the incorporation of UNIST and the registration of others shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree. <Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015>
  [Moved from Article 4; Previous Article 3 moved to Article 2 <Mar. 27, 2015>]

Article 4 (Articles of Incorporation) (1) The following shall be stated in the articles of incorporation of UNIST: <Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015; Act No. 16018, Dec. 24, 2018>
  1. Objectives;
  2. Name;
  3. Location of the principal office;
  4. Matters concerning its affairs and the implementation thereof;
  5. Matters concerning assets and accounting;
  6. Important matters concerning executive officers and employees;
  7. Matters concerning the board of directors;
  8. Matters concerning the Senate;
  9. Matters concerning the amendment of the articles of incorporation;
  10. Matters concerning methods of making official announcements;
  11. Matters concerning dissolution and merger.
  (2) Where UNIST intends to amend its articles of incorporation, it shall obtain authorization from the Minister of Science and ICT. <Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015; Act No. 14839, Jul. 26, 2017>
  (3) Where the Minister of Science and ICT intends to authorize any amendment to the articles of incorporation under paragraph (2), he/she shall obtain prior consent from the Minister of Education. <Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015; Act No. 14839, Jul. 26, 2017>
  [Moved from Article 5; Previous Article 4 moved to Article 3 <Mar. 27, 2015>]

Article 5 (Executive Officers) (1) UNIST shall have up to 15 directors, including one president and one chairperson of the board of directors, and one auditor, and the terms of office shall be as prescribed by the articles of incorporation. <Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015>
  (2) Directors and the auditor shall be elected by the board of directors, as prescribed by the articles of incorporation, and approved by the Minister of Science and ICT. <Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015; Act No. 14839, Jul. 26, 2017>
  (3) Where the Minister of Science and ICT intends to approve the election of directors and the auditor under paragraph (2), he/she shall obtain prior consent from the Minister of Education. <Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015; Act No. 14839, Jul. 26, 2017>
  (4) The chairperson of the board of directors shall be elected from among the directors, as prescribed by the articles of incorporation. <Newly Inserted by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015>
  (5) The chairperson of the board of directors shall not concurrently hold the office of the president of UNIST. <Newly Inserted by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015>
  (6) Executive officers, other than the president or the auditor, shall serve on a part-time basis. <Newly Inserted by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015>
  (7) The auditor shall inspect the affairs and audit the accounts of UNIST. <Newly Inserted by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015>
  [Moved from Article 6; previous Article 5 moved to Article 4 <Mar. 27, 2015>]

Article 6 (President) (1) UNIST shall be headed by the president. <Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015>
  (2) The president shall represent UNIST and preside over its affairs. <Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015>
  (3) The president shall be elected by the board of directors, as prescribed by the articles of incorporation, and approved by the Minister of Science and ICT. <Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015; Act No. 14839, Jul. 26, 2017>
  (4) Where the Minister of Science and ICT intends to approve the election of the president under paragraph (3), he/she shall obtain prior consent from the Minister of Education. <Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015; Act No. 14839, Jul. 26, 2017>
  (5) Duties and the term of office of the president, and other necessary matters, shall be prescribed by the articles of incorporation. <Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015>
  (6) The president may concurrently hold office as a faculty member or researcher. <Newly Inserted by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015>
  [Moved from Article 7; Previous Article 6 moved to Article 5 <Mar. 27, 2015>]

Article 7 (Board of Directors) (1) UNIST shall establish the board of directors to deliberate on and resolve the following: <Amended on Dec. 24, 2018; Jun. 9, 2020>
  1. Matters concerning budgets and the settlement of accounts;
  2. Matters concerning the appointment and dismissal of executive officers;
  3. Matters concerning acquisition, disposal, and management of the important property prescribed by the articles of incorporation;
  4. Matters concerning amendments to the articles of incorporation;
  5. Matters concerning the enactment, amendment, and repeal of important regulations;
  6. Matters prescribed by statutes and subordinate statutes or the articles of incorporation that the resolution of the board of directors is necessary;
  7. Other matters deemed to require a resolution by the board of directors.
  (2) The board of directors shall be comprised of the chairperson and directors. <Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015>
  (3) The chairperson shall convene and preside over meetings of the board of directors. <Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015>
  (4) The auditor may attend meetings of the board of directors and state his/her opinion. <Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015>
  (5) Other matters necessary for the board of directors shall be prescribed by the articles of incorporation. <Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015>
  (6) Deleted. <Mar. 27, 2015>
  (7) Deleted. <Mar. 27, 2015>
  [Moved from Article 9; Previous Article 7 moved to Article 6 <Mar. 27, 2015>]

Article 8 (Faculty Members and Researchers) (1) UNIST shall hire full professors, associate professors and assistant professors as faculty members, and where necessary, it may hire invited professors, lecturers, etc.
  (2) UNIST shall hire necessary researchers to conduct research on science and technology.
  (3) Qualifications for the faculty members referred in paragraph (1) shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.
  [This Article Newly Inserted by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015]

Article 8-2 (Formulation of Plans for Appointment Based on Equal Opportunities for Both Genders) (1) UNIST shall formulate and implement necessary policies for gender equality in the appointment of its faculty members.
  (2) In order to avoid gender bias in appointing faculty members, the president shall, every three years, formulate and implement an employment plan that specifies an appointment target ratio for each college or other plans necessary for implementing proactive measures, in consultation with the Minister of Science and ICT. In such cases, the results of the implementation shall be submitted to the Minister of Science and ICT every year.
  (3) Matters necessary for formulating plans, etc. under paragraph (2) shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.
  [This Article Newly Inserted on Aug. 27, 2019]

Article 9  (Appointment and Dismissal of Faculty Members) (1) The president shall appoint and dismiss the faculty members of UNIST, as prescribed by the articles of incorporation. <Amended by Act No. 16018, Dec. 24, 2018>
  (2) The faculty members of UNIST may be appointed by prescribing the terms of a contract, such as terms of office, salaries, working conditions, and agreements on achievements and work performance, as prescribed by the articles of incorporation. <Newly Inserted by Act No. 16018, Dec. 24, 2018>
  (3) When the appointment period of a faculty member expires, the president shall give a notice (referring to a written notice; hereafter in this Article the same shall apply) to such faculty member of the fact that his/her appointment period is due to expire and he/she may file an application for deliberation on reappointment, by no later than six months before the expiry of his/her appointment period. <Newly Inserted by Act No. 16018, Dec. 24, 2018>
  (4) Where a faculty member in receipt of a notice under paragraph (3) intends to be reappointed, he/she shall file an application for deliberation on reappointment with the president, within 15 days from the date of receipt of such notice. <Newly Inserted by Act No. 16018, Dec. 24, 2018>
  (5) The president shall decide whether to reappoint the relevant faculty member following deliberation on reappointment by the Faculty Personnel Committee under Article 9-2 (1) and shall notify the faculty member of the result of such decision by no later than two months before his/her appointment period expires. In such cases, when the president decides not to reappoint the faculty member, a notice shall be given specifying the intention not to reappoint him/her and the reasons therefor. <Newly Inserted by Act No. 16018, Dec. 24, 2018>
  (6) When the Faculty Personnel Committee referred to in Article 9-2 (1) deliberates on whether to reappoint the relevant faculty member under paragraph (5), such deliberation shall be based on the objective grounds prescribed by the school regulations, such as the evaluation of the following matters. In such cases, the faculty member shall be provided with an opportunity to attend the Faculty Personnel Committee to state his/her opinions or to submit his/her opinions in writing in the course of deliberation: <Newly Inserted by Act No. 16018, Dec. 24, 2018>
  1. Matters concerning education of students;
  2. Matters concerning academic research;
  3. Matter concerning industry-academia cooperation;
  4. Matters concerning contribution activities.
  (7) Where a faculty member who is denied reappointment intends to raise an objection thereto, he/she may file an application for examination with the Teacher’s Appeal Examination Committee established under Article 7 of the Special Act on the Improvement of Teachers’ Status and the Protection of Their Educational Activities, within 30 days from the date he/she becomes aware of such denial. <Newly Inserted by Act No. 16018, Dec. 24, 2018>
  [This Article Newly Inserted by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015]
  [Previous Article 9 moved to Article 7 <Mar. 27, 2015>]

Article 9-2 (Faculty Personnel Committee) (1) The Faculty Personnel Committee shall be established to deliberate on important matters regarding personnel, such as the appointment of faculty members of UNIST.
  (2) Matters necessary for the organization, functions, and operation of the Faculty Personnel Committee shall be prescribed by the articles of incorporation.
  [This Article Newly Inserted by Act No. 16018, Dec. 24, 2018]

Article 9-3 (Tenured Faculty Members) (1) The president may, via the deliberation of the Faculty Members’ Personnel Committee of KAIST, appoint as a faculty member whose employment until the retirement age is guaranteed (hereinafter referred to as "faculty member guaranteed employment until the retirement age") a faculty member who receives excellent evaluation with respect to education, academic research, industry-academic cooperation and donatory service or a faculty member who is recognized as an authority in any specific specialized field. <Amended on Jun. 9, 2020>
  (2) Matters concerning faculty members subject to evaluation for tenure, an evaluation period, the number of deliberations, and items and methods of evaluation shall be prescribed by the school regulations.
  (3) Article 9 (3) through (7) shall apply mutatis mutandis to procedures for deliberation on tenured faculty members.
  [This Article Newly Inserted by Act No. 16018, Dec. 24, 2018]

Article 10 (Conferment of Degrees) The president shall confer doctor's, professional master's, master's and bachelor's degrees, as prescribed by school regulations.
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015]

Article 11 (Students) The president shall determine the maximum number of students of, qualifications for admission and methods of admission to UNIST, and report his/her determinations to the Minister of Science and ICT and the Minister of Education, as prescribed by Presidential Decree. <Amended by Act No. 14839, Jul. 26, 2017>
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015]

Article 12 (Business Year) The business year of UNIST shall coincide with the fiscal year of the State.
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015]

Article 13  (Support, Adjustment, etc.) The Minister of Science and ICT shall support and develop UNIST, and coordinate and supervise its affairs. <Amended by Act No. 14839, Jul. 26, 2017>
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015]

Article 14 (Contributions) (1) The State, a local government or public institution under Article 4 of the Act on the Management of Public Institutions may grant contributions to UNIST within budgetary limits so that it may cover expenses incurred in the establishment, construction, research and management thereof. <Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015>
  (2) Matters necessary for the granting and using contributions under paragraph (1) shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree. <Amended by Act No. 8852, Feb. 29, 2008; Act No. 11690, Mar. 23, 2013; Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015>
  (3) Deleted. <by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015>
  [Moved from Article 16; previous Article 14 Deleted]

Article 15 (Transfer, etc. of State-Owned or Public Property) (1) Notwithstanding the provisions of other Acts, the State or a local government may transfer State-owned property, public property, and its assets to UNIST for the establishment thereof: Provided, That State-owned cultural heritage and State-owned natural heritage under Article 66 of the Act on Preservation and Utilization of Cultural Heritage (including cases to be applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to Article 63 of the Act on Preservation and Utilization of Natural Heritage) shall be excluded. <Amended on Mar. 27, 2015; Mar. 21, 2023; Aug. 8, 2023>
  (2) Where necessary for the management of UNIST, notwithstanding the provisions of other Acts, the State or local governments may lease State-owned property, public property, or goods to UNIST without compensation, or permit it to use State-owned property and make a profit on State-owned property without compensation. <Amended on Mar. 27, 2015; Jan. 11, 2022>
  (3) Where the head of a central administrative agency intends to transfer State-owned property pursuant to paragraph (1), he/she shall consult with the Minister of Strategy and Finance. <Amended by Act No. 8852, Feb. 29, 2008>
  (4) Where the State leases State-owned property to UNIST without compensation or permits it to use State-owned property and make a profit on State-owned property without compensation pursuant to paragraph (2), the details, conditions of, and procedures for such lease of and permission to use and make a profit on State-owned property without compensation shall be stipulated by a contract between a management agency of the relevant property and UNIST. <Amended by Act No. 9401, Jan. 30, 2009; Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015>
  [Moved from Article 17; previous Article 15 Deleted]

Article 16 (Degree Courses, etc.) (1) UNIST shall provide doctorate, professional master's, master's and bachelor's degree courses.
  (2) The president shall determine matters concerning the years required for each decree course, terms, the number of school days, departments, majors, curricula, etc. of each degree course under paragraph (1), and report such matters to the Minister of Science and ICT, and the Minister of Education, as prescribed by Presidential Decree. <Amended by Act No. 14839, Jul. 26, 2017>
  (3) Except as otherwise expressly prescribed by this Act, the Higher Education Act shall apply to the conferment of doctor's, professional master's, master's and bachelor's degrees under paragraph (1), qualifications for the faculty members, qualifications for admission, methods of admission, etc.
  [This Article Newly Inserted by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015]
  [Previous Article 16 moved to Article 14 <Mar. 27, 2015>]

Article 16-2 (Senate) (1) The Senate shall be established within UNIST to deliberate on the following matters: Provided, That the matters referred to in subparagraph 2 shall be referred only for consultation:
  1. Matters concerning a mid- to long-term development plan;
  2. Important matters concerning the operation of educational courses and research;
  3. Important matters concerning the welfare of faculty members, staff, and students;
  4. Important matters prescribed by the articles of incorporation with regard to the operation of UNIST;
  5. Matters requiring deliberation as the president, the chairperson, or at least 1/3 of Senate members deem important for the operation of the school.
  (2) The Senate shall be comprised of at least 11 Senate members who represent each group, such as faculty members, staff (including researchers), and students, and may include the alumni of UNIST and persons who can contribute to its development. In such cases, the number of Senate members belonging to a certain group shall not exceed 1/2 of the fixed number of Senate members.
  (3) Article 19-2 (3) through (6) of the Higher Education Act shall apply mutatis mutandis to matters regarding the chairperson and vice-chairperson of the Senate, the terms of office of Senate members, submission of materials and preparation of minutes. In such cases, "head of a school" shall be construed as "president."
  (4) The Senate shall send the results of deliberation to the president, who shall refer to the board of directors matters which require resolution by the board of directors or are deemed important.
  (5) Other matters necessary to organize and operate the Senate shall be determined by the articles of incorporation, as prescribed by Presidential Decree.
  [This Article Newly Inserted by Act No. 16018, Dec. 24, 2018]

Article 17 (Establishment of Fund, etc.) (1) Where necessary to raise and supply funds necessary for efficiently conducting research and development of science and technology and educational management, UNIST may establish the Development Fund (hereinafter referred to as the "Fund").
  (2) The Fund shall be created with the following financial resources:
  1. Investments or contributions made by persons other than the Government;
  2. Proceeds from the operation of the Fund;
  3. Other revenues prescribed by Presidential Decree.
  (3) The Fund shall be used for any of the following purposes:
  1. Expenditure of funds for research and development of science and technology;
  2. Establishment and operation of large-scale educational facilities or research facilities;
  3. Expenditure of funds necessary for other projects prescribed by Presidential Decree in order to achieve the objectives of the establishment of the Fund.
  (4) Other matters necessary for the operation and management of the Fund shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.
  [This Article Newly Inserted by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015]
  [Previous Article 17 moved to Article 15 <Mar. 27, 2015>]

Article 17-2 (Donation, etc.) (1) Any person who donated land, research facilities, or research equipment and materials, etc. to UNIST may use them jointly with UNIST for a specified period.
  (2) Procedures for donation of land, research facilities, or research equipment and materials, etc. and matters necessary for joint use thereof shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.
  [This Article Newly Inserted by Act No. 15244, Dec. 19, 2017]

Article 18 (Submission of Business Plan, etc.) (1) UNIST shall submit a business plan and a budget proposal to the Minister of Science and ICT and obtain his/her approval before each business year begins, as prescribed by Presidential Decree. In such cases, a business plan and a budget proposal for academic affairs shall also be submitted to the Minister of Education. <Amended by Act No. 14839, Jul. 26, 2017>
  (2) UNIST shall submit to the Minister of Science and ICT a settlement of accounts concerning revenues and expenditures of each business year audited by a certified public accountant or accounting firm designated by the Minister of Science and ICT. In such cases, a settlement of revenues and expenditures on academic affairs shall also be submitted to the Minister of Education. <Amended by Act No. 14839, Jul. 26, 2017>
  (3) Among the matters stated in a settlement of accounts under paragraph (2), matters falling under any of the following may be excluded from items subject to the audit conducted by a certified public accountant or accounting firm:
  1. Research affairs classified as State secrets;
  2. Affairs directly related to subparagraph 1;
  3. Among tasks outsourced by businesses, research affairs of which UNIST is requested to protect the secrecy by businesses that outsource it with such research affairs.
  [This Article Newly Inserted by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015]

Article 19 (Submission of Research Plan, Research Report, etc.) (1) UNIST shall submit a research plan and a research report to the Minister of Science and ICT, as prescribed by Presidential Decree: Provided, That the foregoing shall not apply to research outsourced contractually. <Amended by Act No. 14839, Jul. 26, 2017>
  (2) The Minister of Science and ICT shall review and evaluate a research plan and a research report submitted thereto him/her pursuant to paragraph (1), and where necessary, he/she shall require UNIST to take necessary measures, such as amendments to such research plan and complements to the details of research conducted, or recommend it to disseminate its research outcomes. <Amended by Act No. 14839, Jul. 26, 2017>
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015]

Article 20 (Joint Research on Specific Tasks, etc.) Where the Minister of Science and ICT deems it necessary to conduct joint research on specific tasks, he/she may take appropriate measures necessary for joint research, or recommend the president of UNIST to take necessary measures. <Amended by Act No. 14839, Jul. 26, 2017>
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015]

Article 21 (Joint Use of Research Facilities, etc.) For the improvement of productivity of research and the efficient use of research facilities, UNIST shall endeavor to use research facilities, apparatus, etc. jointly in consultation with other research institutions, universities, specialized organizations, etc. In such cases, UNIST may require any institutions that use them to share all or some expenses incurred while using them.
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015]

Article 22 (Profit-Making Business, etc.) (1) UNIST may conduct profit-making business to the extent that such business does not interfere with its educational and research activities. <Amended on Mar. 27, 2015; Jul. 26, 2017; Jan. 11, 2022>
  (2) UNIST may, if necessary to achieve its objectives, establish a corporation that conducts profit-making business under paragraph (1). In such cases, the independence and autonomy of the corporation shall be guaranteed. <Newly Inserted on Nov. 11, 2022>
  (3) A corporation referred to in paragraph (2) shall conduct only the activities necessary to achieve the objectives of UNIST, such as technology transfer and commercialization, and support for start-ups. <Newly Inserted on Nov. 11, 2022>
  (4) Profits under paragraph (1) or (2) shall be appropriated for the management and research of UNIST. <Amended on Mar. 27, 2015; Jan. 11, 2022>
  (5) Matters necessary for the profit-making business under paragraph (1) and the establishment, etc. of a corporation under paragraph (2) shall be prescribed by the articles of incorporation. <Newly Inserted on Nov. 11, 2022>
  [Moved from Article 23; previous Article 22 Deleted]

Article 22-2 (Promotion of Technology Transfer and Commercialization) UNIST shall endeavor to promote the transfer and commercialization of the technology it possesses in order to spread and utilize the research results.
  [This Article Newly Inserted on Jan. 11, 2022]

Article 22-3 (Support for Startup) (1) UNIST may support business start-up by teachers, employees, and students.
  (2) Matters necessary for supporting business start-ups under paragraph (1) shall be prescribed by school regulations.
  [This Article Newly Inserted on Jan. 11, 2022]

Article 23 (Prohibition of Use of Similar Name) No person other than UNIST shall use the name "Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology" or similar.
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015]
  [Moved from Article 24; Previous Article 23 moved to Article 22 <Mar. 27, 2015>]

Article 24 (Obligations to Maintain Confidentiality) No current or former executive officer or employee of UNIST shall divulge or misappropriate any of confidential information he/she has become aware of officially.
  [This Article Newly Inserted by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015]
  [Previous Article 24 moved to Article 23 <Mar. 27, 2015>]

Article 25 (Application Mutatis Mutandis of the Civil Act) Except as otherwise provided in this Act, the provisions regarding incorporated foundations in the Civil Act shall apply mutatis mutandis to UNIST. <Amended on Mar. 27, 2015; Jun. 9, 2020>

Article 26 (Penalty Provisions) Any person who divulges or misappropriates any confidential information, in violation of Article 24, shall be punished by imprisonment with or without prison labor for not more than three years or by a fine not exceeding 30 million won.
  [This Article Newly Inserted by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015]
  [Previous Article 26 moved to Article 27 <Mar. 27, 2015>]

Article 27 (Administrative Fines) (1) Any person who uses the name "Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology" or similar, in violation of Article 23, shall be punished by an administrative fine not exceeding five million won. <Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015>
  (2) The Minister of Science and ICT shall impose and collect administrative fines under paragraph (1), as prescribed by Presidential Decree. <Amended on Feb. 29, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013; Jul. 26, 2017; Jun. 9, 2020>
  (3) Deleted. <Mar. 23, 2013>
  (4) Deleted. <Mar. 23, 2013>
  (5) Deleted. <Mar. 23, 2013>
  [Moved from Article 26; Previous Article 27 moved to Article 28 <Mar. 27, 2015>]

Article 28 (Legal Fiction as Public Officials in Application of Penalty Provisions) Where the provisions of Articles 129 through 132 of the Criminal Act are applied, executive officers and employees of UNIST shall be deemed public officials.
  [This Article Wholly Amended by Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015]
  [Moved from Article 27 <Mar. 27, 2015>]

ADDENDA <Act No. 13230, Mar. 27, 2015>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Act shall enter into force six months after the date of its promulgation.
Article 2 (Preparatory Committee for Establishment)
(1) The Minister of Science, ICT and Future Planning shall establish the Preparatory Committee for the Establishment of UNIST (hereinafter referred to as the "Preparatory Committee for Establishment") within three months from the enforcement date of this Act in order to deal with affairs concerning the dissolution of the former National Corporate University, Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology under the Act on the Establishment and Management of Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology before this Act enters into force, and the establishment of UNIST.
(2) The Preparatory Committee for Establishment shall be comprised of up to ten members commissioned by the Minister of Science, ICT and Future Planning, and the chairperson shall be appointed by the Minister of Science, ICT and Future Planning from among its members.
(3) The Preparatory Committee for Establishment shall prepare the articles of incorporation of UNIST, obtain approval for the articles of incorporation from the Minister of Science, ICT and Future Planning, and complete the registration for the incorporation of UNIST by the enforcement date of this Act, and transfer its affairs to the president of UNIST.
(4) Members of the Preparatory Committee for Establishment shall be deemed dismissed or decommissioned when the transfer of affairs under paragraph (3) is completed.
Article 3 (Special Cases of Dissolution and Liquidation)
Notwithstanding provisions regarding the dissolution and liquidation of a corporation of the Civil Act, the National Corporate University, Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology shall be deemed dissolved simultaneously with the establishment of UNIST under this Act.
Article 4 (Transitional Measures concerning Succession, etc. to Rights and Obligations)
(1) UNIST under this Act shall comprehensively succeed to the rights and obligations of the former National Corporate University, Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology.
(2) The name of the former National Corporate University, Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology indicated in the register concerning the rights and obligations to which UNIST comprehensively succeeds pursuant to paragraph (1) or other official books shall be construed as the name of UNIST under this Act.
(3) Any acts done by the president of the former National Corporate University, Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology for the management of the University shall be construed as any acts done by the president of UNIST.
(4) Undergraduates and graduates of the former National Corporate University, Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology, and persons expelled therefrom or persons whose names were removed from the list thereof shall be deemed undergraduates and graduates of UNIST under this Act, and persons expelled therefrom or persons whose names were removed from the list thereof.
Article 5 (Transitional Measures concerning Budget at Time of Establishment)
(1) UNIST under this Act may implement the budget under the jurisdiction of the former National Corporate University, Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology following the previous example until the budget of UNIST is determined at the time it is established.
(2) Where the budget of UNIST is approved, expenses incurred pursuant to paragraph (1) shall be deemed spent according to the approved budget.
Article 6 (Transitional Measures concerning Executive Officers and Employees)
(1) Except as otherwise prescribed by the Preparatory Committee for Establishment, the president, directors and auditor of the National Corporate University, Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology as at the time this Act enters into force, shall be deemed appointed to the position of president, directors and auditor of UNIST under this Act: Provided, That their terms of office shall be the remainder of the unexpired terms of office under the former provisions.
(2) Employees who are serving with the former National Corporate University, Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology as at the time UNIST is established shall be deemed appointed to the same position of UNIST pursuant to this Act.
Article 7 Omitted.
